note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000. trade: free_trade because the EU-Turkey Customs Union for industrial goods took effect on 31 December 1995. political_freedom: restricted_elections because the Constitutional Court could close parties (it closed the Virtue Party in June 2001 and HADEP in March 2003) and a 10% national threshold applied to parliamentary seats; elections were otherwise competitive. civil_rights: limited_civil_liberties because state-of-emergency (OHAL) rule applied in several south-eastern provinces from 1987 to 2002. religion_state: strict_secularism reflects the secular republic founded in 1923. conscription: compulsory military service for male citizens. economic_system, healthcare, education, immigration, energy_policy, press_freedom and internet_surveillance are judgement calls for gameplay, not sourced findings.
